When you purchase a mortgage, you have to prove the source of your down payment.  Primarily this is so that the mortgage lender knows that there are no other outstanding liens against the property.  If you show that some or part of your down payment was a gift, there is no fraud, but it may affect your qualification for the mortgage. Consult a lawyer in your area to determine if there is a legal way to gift the money
